description: This file contains unit tests for the ValidationUniqueDao class in the OrangeHRM project. The tests verify the uniqueness checks for employee IDs, usernames, and email subscriptions within the application's data layer.

classes.name: ValidationUniqueDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the ValidationUniqueDao's methods related to uniqueness validation of employee IDs, usernames, and email subscriptions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case, creates an instance of ValidationUniqueDao, and populates test data fixtures.

methods.name: testIsValueUniqueForEmployeeId
methods.description: Tests that the isValueUnique method correctly identifies non-unique employee IDs.

methods.name: testIsValueUniqueForSystemUser
methods.description: Tests that the isValueUnique method correctly handles username uniqueness checks, considering different user IDs and deletion states.

methods.name: testIsValueUniqueForEmailSubscriber
methods.description: Tests email uniqueness validation, ensuring email address uniqueness with respect to different subscribers and email notification states.
